description: Integration (DB-backed): supplied-app setup followed by recorded admin consent leaves one platform profile with email and calendar capabilities and bindings for both consumers; getMicrosoftCalendarSetupStatus reports ready with source supplied app.
Integration (DB-backed): when Calendar is already bound to a tenant-owned profile, supplied-app consent binds email only and leaves the Calendar binding untouched.

Integration (DB-backed): a consented platform profile with capabilities ['email'] and no Calendar binding gains the calendar capability and binding on first calendar readiness read; a second run and two concurrent runs produce no duplicates or errors.

Integration (DB-backed): reconciliation does nothing for a platform profile pending consent, an archived platform profile, a tenant-owned profile, and a tenant whose Calendar binding points at another profile.
Unit: consent recorded for a tenant-owned email profile binds only email, as before.
Unit: with the supplied app not offered (self-hosted licensing), setup is still refused, reconciliation is a no-op and calendar status reports platformOffered false.

Component (MicrosoftCalendarProviderForm): supplied-app ready state hides Entra app registration instructions and shows supplied-app copy; tenant-owned ready state shows the Entra instructions; not-configured state links to the provider setup entry.

Component (MicrosoftIntegrationSettings): supplied-app ready banner shows mailbox and calendar actions pointing at the mailbox and calendar setup entry paths in EE, and only the mailbox action when calendar is not served.
Unit (calendar callback): Microsoft consent-required and admin-approval-required responses map to the distinct error code; other errors keep the generic code.
Component (MicrosoftCalendarProviderForm): the admin-approval error shows the message, and the consent link appears only for a user with provider settings permission.
